findings.what: Д3 (c) is not built as decided for one place of the J01 kind: the removal of the test's own folder runs outside withoutPath, so a Node system error of it passes with the temporary path, and, thrown from the finally, it replaces an error that withoutPath has already told without its path. Measured: TV12 (an unremovable folder left in the data folder at the exit) create red "EACCES: permission denied, unlink '<tmp>/sai-e2e-team-web-<id>/...'"; TV13 (the data folder made 0000 at the exit) create red "EACCES: permission denied, scandir '<tmp>/sai-e2e-team-web-<id>/data'", the stack in removeTempDir, while the after-stop reading's own EACCES would have been told by withoutPath. The place is neither covered nor named in result.issues of step 6 (I3 lists planTasks/runOf, kit errors and spawn errors only), and step 6 says 'one helper covers the kind'.
findings.fix: Send the removal's error through withoutPath too and keep the body's error first when both fail (measured form FX1: the removal in a try with catch -> throw withoutPath(err); TV12 and TV13 then red with 'a system error: unlink EACCES' and 'a system error: scandir EACCES', the temporary root 0 times; today's whole file 7 of 7 green). Or, if ORCH prefers, name it as the limit Д3 (c) allows, for a new defect.

findings.what: scrollX === 0 forbids only the window's sideways scroll; the check's own scrollIntoView also scrolls an inner box whose sideways overflow is hidden, a scroll the person cannot do, so a button the person cannot see counts as inside. Measured (TV05 and its measuring twin TV05m): at 320x568, before the check the button lies at 419-554 px in a 320 px window, its centre outside the window, the document 320 px wide (nothing to scroll), the form's overflow-x hidden; the check scrolled the form by 243 px, scrollX stayed 0, and windows is green with the new and the old file. The same kind as L2 in the same assertion (AP-014; AP-159 (5): a check «inside» forbids the scroll it does not allow). The task set the form 'scrollX 0', so the form is ORCH's to change.
findings.fix: Also read the button's sideways position before the scroll, as picker.e2e.js does: left >= 0 and right <= innerWidth before scrollIntoView, then the rectangle after it (measured form FX2: red on TV05, M11b and TV06b, green on today's page; on today's page the position before the scroll is 19-154 px at 320x568, measured by K0m).
